name: postcode
abstract: UK postcode type optimised for indexing, plus postal_code for the postal codes of any country
description: Two types for postal codes. postcode: a 32-bit UK postcode optimised for indexing and partial matches, and dps for delivery point suffixes -- created by Dave Green (version 1.3.0); later versions by John Burns fix a heap overflow in postcode_out() and an unsafe % index registration, and add compatibility with PostgreSQL 14 and later. postal_code (new in 2.0.0): a 64-bit type for any country, written CC-code as the UPU recommends ('US-90210', 'GB-SW1A 1AA'), with formats for 194 of the 250 ISO 3166-1 countries and territories (the other 56 have no postal codes). Values sort by country in ISO order then by their own code; prefixes are index range scans (postal_prefix(), lower_bound(), upper_bound(), the % operator); outcode(); is_valid_postal_code() and to_postal_code() for loading dirty feeds; a column can be locked to a country, postal_code('US'); and a new country needs SQL (add_country_template) and no C. Validated on 117 million OpenStreetMap postcodes, 1.8 million GeoNames codes and Companies House addresses -- see VALIDATION.md. Upgrading from 1.3.x is ALTER EXTENSION postcode UPDATE; the existing types are unchanged.

x_original.note: The original UK postcode package (postcode and dps, version 1.3.0) was created by Dave Green (patchsoft). All later versions, 1.3.1 onward, and the international postal_code type were created by John Burns.
